import json, re

with open("raw.srt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# split into blocks separated by blank lines
blocks = re.split(r"\n\s*\n", content.strip())
items = []
for b in blocks:
    lines = [ln for ln in b.splitlines() if ln.strip() != "" or True]
    lines = b.splitlines()
    if len(lines) < 2:
        continue
    # find index line (first all-digit line)
    i0 = 0
    while i0 < len(lines) and not lines[i0].strip().isdigit():
        i0 += 1
    if i0 >= len(lines) - 1:
        continue
    try:
        idx = int(lines[i0].strip())
    except ValueError:
        continue
    time_line = lines[i0 + 1].strip()
    if "-->" not in time_line:
        continue
    text = "\n".join(lines[i0 + 2:]).strip()
    items.append({"index": idx, "time": time_line, "text": text})

CHUNK = 20
chunks = []
for ci, start in enumerate(range(0, len(items), CHUNK)):
    chunks.append({"id": ci, "items": items[start:start + CHUNK]})

with open("chunks.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump({"chunks": chunks}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("wrote chunks.json: %d items in %d chunks" % (len(items), len(chunks)))

import json

with open("chunks_corrected.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

items = []
for ch in data.get("chunks", []):
    for it in ch.get("items", []):
        items.append({
            "index": int(it["index"]),
            "time": str(it["time"]),
            "text": str(it.get("text", "")),
        })

items.sort(key=lambda x: x["index"])

lines = []
for it in items:
    lines.append(str(it["index"]))
    lines.append(it["time"])
    lines.append(it["text"])
    lines.append("")

with open("corrected.srt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print("wrote corrected.srt: %d subtitles" % len(items))
